encoder: 4 Sonnet 5.5 agents (claude-sonnet-5-5), a keel and 3 parts working in parallel from per-agent briefs, merged by a lead agent; each part read by an independent Opus test author
display_name: Supreme Court of Judicature Act 1969 (Singapore): layer-1 modules and an individual's seat
maintainer: undetermined: to be set when the row is deposited
edition: Supreme Court of Judicature Act 1969, 2020 Revised Edition, informal consolidation, banner "version in force from 1/7/2024" (SCJA1969.txt line 16); retrieved from Singapore Statutes Online on 2026-10-01, whose metadata says "Current version as at 01 Oct 2026"; converted to plain text (SCJA1969.txt, 7,314 lines)
seat: a person who wishes to start, defend or appeal a civil case in the Singapore High Court or Court of Appeal, asking on facts they can state which court hears it, who may appear, what jurisdiction and powers apply, and the time limits the Act itself sets

scope.encoded: every range of the text, by agent: keel lines 1 to 45, scja1 lines 46 to 2309, scja2 lines 2310 to 4320, scja3 lines 4321 to 7314; each part's coverage table is in notes/<agent>-NOTES.md
scope.inputs_not_encoded: figures, orders and other instruments the text leaves outside it are plain inputs, listed in the parts' Seams sections

not_reviewed: No lawyer or other domain expert has read this encoding against the text, and it has not been checked against the official text. The text it quotes is a converter's rendering. The readings the parts flag for a lawyer (notes/<part>-NOTES.md) are not ruled beyond Meng's four rulings recorded in NOTES.md.
